audio.t: Just a reminder that the company's e-mail system will be migrated to the new platform this weekend.
Will we be able to access our messages on Saturday? I'm on call for customer support.
Only through your phone. The web version will be down from Saturday morning until Sunday evening.
What about our contact lists? It took me ages to build mine.
Those will be transferred automatically. But I'd recommend exporting a copy on Friday, just to be safe.

questions.prompt: What will happen this weekend?
options: A training session will take place.
A customer support office will close.
An e-mail system will be moved to a new platform.
questions.evidence: the company's e-mail system will be migrated to the new platform this weekend
questions.explanation: La messagerie de l'entreprise migre vers une nouvelle plateforme ce week-end.

questions.prompt: Why is the first man concerned?
options: He has lost his contact list.
He has to work on Saturday.
He does not have a company phone.
questions.evidence: I'm on call for customer support.
questions.explanation: Il est d'astreinte (« on call ») samedi pour le support client : il doit pouvoir lire ses messages ce jour-là.

questions.prompt: What does the woman recommend?
options: Saving a backup copy of contacts
questions.evidence: I'd recommend exporting a copy on Friday
questions.explanation: Elle conseille d'exporter une copie des contacts vendredi, par précaution : une sauvegarde.
questions.traps: La version web sera justement indisponible.
questions.takeaway: Just to be safe = par précaution.

audio.t: Hi, I need a banner for our company's booth at a career fair this Saturday.
Sure. Do you know how much space you have?
The back wall of the booth is one meter thirty wide, and the organizers don't allow banners wider than the wall. I'd like the biggest one possible.
OK. If you send us your design by Thursday noon, it'll be ready on Friday afternoon.
Great, our designer will e-mail it today.

questions.prompt: What event is the man preparing for?
questions.evidence: a banner for our company's booth at a career fair
questions.explanation: La bannière est destinée au stand de l'entreprise sur un salon de l'emploi.
questions.takeaway: Career fair = salon de l'emploi / du recrutement.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. How much will the man most likely pay?
questions.explanation: Le mur mesure 1,30 m et la bannière ne doit pas être plus large ; il veut la plus grande possible : la taille Large (120 cm) à 80 €.
questions.traps: L'Extra Large (150 cm) dépasse la largeur du mur.
questions.takeaway: Graphiques : applique chaque contrainte entendue (largeur max + « the biggest possible »).

questions.prompt: What does the woman say about the design?
options: It must be received by a deadline.
It will be created by her team.
It should include the company logo.
questions.evidence: If you send us your design by Thursday noon
questions.explanation: Le fichier doit être envoyé avant jeudi midi pour que la bannière soit prête vendredi : c'est une date limite.

audio.t: Hi Tom, I heard you signed up to mentor one of the new graduates.
Yes, I'm meeting her for the first time on Wednesday. To be honest, I'm a little nervous. I've never mentored anyone.
You'll be fine. When I did it last year, HR gave us a really useful guide with discussion topics for each meeting.
Oh, I didn't get anything like that.
I still have mine. I'll drop it off at your desk after lunch.

questions.prompt: What did the man recently do?
options: He volunteered to guide a new employee.
questions.evidence: you signed up to mentor one of the new graduates
questions.explanation: Il s'est porté volontaire pour accompagner (« mentor ») une jeune diplômée récemment embauchée.
questions.takeaway: Sign up to = s'inscrire pour, se porter volontaire.

questions.prompt: Why does the man say, "I didn't get anything like that"?
options: To complain about the HR department
To indicate that he lacks a useful resource
To explain why he is late
questions.evidence: Oh, I didn't get anything like that.
questions.explanation: Il n'a pas reçu le guide dont parle sa collègue : il lui manque cette ressource. Elle propose alors de lui prêter le sien.
questions.takeaway: La réaction de l'autre personne confirme l'intention.

questions.prompt: What will the woman do after lunch?
questions.evidence: I'll drop it off at your desk after lunch.
questions.explanation: Elle déposera son guide sur le bureau de Tom après le déjeuner.

audio.t: Ingrid, the fish delivery still hasn't arrived, and we open in two hours.
I just called the supplier. Their truck broke down on the highway.
That's a problem. Tonight's special is the grilled salmon, and we have forty reservations.
The market on Rue Colbert sells fresh salmon. It'll cost more, but it's only ten minutes away.
Let's do that. I'll send Antoine with the van right now.

questions.prompt: Where do the speakers most likely work?
questions.evidence: Tonight's special is the grilled salmon, and we have forty reservations.
questions.explanation: Plat du jour, réservations, ouverture dans deux heures : ils travaillent dans un restaurant.

questions.prompt: Why hasn't the delivery arrived?
options: The supplier ran out of fish.
questions.evidence: Their truck broke down on the highway.
questions.explanation: Le camion du fournisseur est tombé en panne sur l'autoroute.

questions.prompt: What does the woman imply about the market on Rue Colbert?
questions.evidence: It'll cost more
questions.explanation: « It'll cost more » : acheter au marché sera plus cher que chez le fournisseur habituel.
questions.takeaway: Imply = sous-entendre ; la réponse reformule une remarque brève.

audio.t: The packaging samples came back from the printer, and the color is off. The logo looks purple instead of blue.
Oh no. We're launching in three weeks.
I've worked with that printer before. They usually reprint in five days.
Five days still leaves us time to stock the stores.
OK, let's request a reprint today, and I'll ask them to send a proof first.

questions.prompt: What problem are the speakers discussing?
options: A store ran out of stock.
questions.evidence: the color is off
questions.explanation: Les échantillons d'emballage ont une mauvaise couleur : le logo est violet au lieu de bleu.
questions.takeaway: The color is off = la couleur n'est pas bonne.

questions.prompt: Why does the second woman say, "They usually reprint in five days"?
options: To reassure her colleagues about the schedule
To complain about the printer's speed
questions.evidence: They usually reprint in five days.
questions.explanation: Face à l'inquiétude sur le lancement dans trois semaines, elle indique que la réimpression sera rapide ; l'homme confirme qu'il reste du temps.
questions.takeaway: Intention : réponse rassurante à une inquiétude exprimée juste avant.

questions.prompt: What does the first woman say she will request?
options: A sample to check before printing
questions.evidence: I'll ask them to send a proof first
questions.explanation: Elle demandera d'abord une épreuve (« proof ») : un exemplaire de contrôle avant l'impression définitive.

audio.t: Are you going to the Logistics Forum tomorrow?
Yes, but my train only gets in at ten fifteen, so I'll miss the opening and most of the panel.
Too bad, the panel looks great. Anyway, the session I really want to see is the one right after the panel.
Me too. I'll be there in time for that one, so I'll save you a seat.

questions.prompt: Why will the man arrive late?
options: He has a meeting in the morning.
He has to give a presentation.
His train arrives after the forum begins.
questions.evidence: my train only gets in at ten fifteen
questions.explanation: Son train arrive à 10 h 15, après le début du forum (9 h).

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which session does the woman most want to attend?
questions.explanation: Elle veut voir la session juste après le panel : l'atelier « Data Tools » de 11 h 30.
questions.traps: Le panel lui plaît (« looks great ») mais ce n'est pas la session qu'elle veut surtout voir.
questions.takeaway: « The one right after… » : repère la position dans le tableau.

questions.prompt: What does the man offer to do?
options: Save a seat for the woman
Pick the woman up at the station
questions.evidence: I'll save you a seat.
questions.explanation: L'homme arrivera à temps pour l'atelier et propose de garder une place à sa collègue.
questions.takeaway: Save someone a seat = garder une place à quelqu'un.

audio.t: This is Radio Metro with your eight o'clock traffic update. Drivers heading into the city on the A6 should expect delays of up to forty minutes because of roadwork near the Porte d'Italie exit. The work is scheduled to continue until Friday, so if you can, consider taking the train this week. Meanwhile, the Pont Neuf bridge has reopened to traffic after last week's repairs. Our next update will be at eight thirty, right after the news.

questions.prompt: What is causing delays on the A6?
questions.evidence: because of roadwork near the Porte d'Italie exit
questions.explanation: Les retards sont dus à des travaux routiers (« roadwork »).

questions.prompt: What does the speaker suggest?
questions.evidence: consider taking the train this week
questions.explanation: Elle suggère de prendre le train cette semaine : les transports en commun.

questions.prompt: What is said about the Pont Neuf bridge?
questions.evidence: has reopened to traffic
questions.explanation: Le pont a rouvert à la circulation après les réparations.
questions.traps: (C) : les réparations ont eu lieu la semaine dernière.

audio.t: Thanks for joining this morning. I'd like to share some news about our flexible work policy. Starting in January, employees will be able to work from home up to two days a week. To make this possible, we're introducing a desk-booking app, so you'll reserve a desk for the days you're in the office. I know some of you are worried about losing your usual desk. Well, each team will have its own zone, so you'll still sit near your colleagues. Ricardo from IT will run short training sessions on the app next week.

questions.prompt: What is the talk mainly about?
questions.evidence: some news about our flexible work policy
questions.explanation: Il annonce la nouvelle politique de travail flexible (télétravail deux jours par semaine).

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker say, "each team will have its own zone"?
options: To ask teams to choose a location
To explain a new security rule
questions.evidence: each team will have its own zone
questions.explanation: Il répond à l'inquiétude mentionnée juste avant (perdre son bureau habituel) : chacun restera près de ses collègues.
questions.takeaway: « I know some of you are worried… Well, … » = réponse à une inquiétude.

questions.prompt: What will Ricardo do next week?
questions.evidence: Ricardo from IT will run short training sessions on the app next week.
questions.explanation: Ricardo animera de courtes formations sur l'application.
questions.takeaway: Run a session = animer une session.

graphic.title: Aero Headphones — Units Sold Last Year

audio.t: Let's look at last year's sales figures for the Aero headphones. As you can see, sales dropped slightly in the second quarter, when a competitor launched a similar product. But in the following quarter, after we reduced the price and started our social media campaign, sales reached their highest level of the year. This year, we want to repeat that success, so our team will launch a new campaign in March. I'd like each of you to send me three ideas by Friday.

questions.prompt: Who most likely are the listeners?
questions.evidence: our team will launch a new campaign in March
questions.explanation: L'équipe prépare une campagne et doit proposer des idées : ce sont des membres d'une équipe marketing.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. How many units were sold in the quarter after the price was reduced?
questions.explanation: Après la baisse de prix (au trimestre suivant le T2), les ventes atteignent leur maximum : T3, 6 100 unités.
questions.traps: 3 900 correspond au T2, le trimestre de la baisse des ventes.
questions.takeaway: « The following quarter » + « highest level » : deux indices convergent.

questions.prompt: What are the listeners asked to do?
questions.evidence: send me three ideas by Friday
questions.explanation: Chacun doit envoyer trois idées d'ici vendredi.

audio.t: Welcome to the Maritime Museum. Before we start, a few practical points. Our tour today will last about an hour and will end in the gift shop on the ground floor. Photography is allowed in most galleries, but please turn off your flash, as bright light can damage the old maps on display. If you need a break during the tour, there are benches in every room. Now, let's begin with our most famous exhibit: a full-size replica of a nineteenth-century fishing boat.

questions.prompt: Who most likely is the speaker?
questions.evidence: Our tour today will last about an hour
questions.explanation: Il accueille des visiteurs et présente le déroulement de la visite : c'est un guide.
questions.takeaway: Tour, exhibit, galleries → guide de musée.

questions.prompt: Why are listeners asked to turn off their flash?
questions.evidence: bright light can damage the old maps on display
questions.explanation: La lumière vive peut abîmer les cartes anciennes exposées : il faut protéger les objets.
questions.traps: (C) est faux : la photo est autorisée dans la plupart des salles.

questions.prompt: What will the listeners see first?
questions.evidence: a full-size replica of a nineteenth-century fishing boat
questions.explanation: La visite commence par une réplique grandeur nature d'un bateau de pêche : une maquette / un modèle.

audio.t: Thank you for calling Greenline Energy. Please note that our offices are closed today for a national holiday. If you are calling to report a gas leak or a power outage, hang up and dial our emergency line at 0800 555 211, which is available twenty-four hours a day. For billing questions, you can also visit our website, where you can view your account and pay online. Otherwise, please call back tomorrow from eight A.M. Our wait times are usually shortest in the afternoon.

questions.prompt: Why are the offices closed?
questions.evidence: closed today for a national holiday
questions.explanation: Les bureaux sont fermés pour un jour férié national.

questions.prompt: What should callers do to report an emergency?
questions.evidence: hang up and dial our emergency line
questions.explanation: Pour une urgence, il faut raccrocher et composer le numéro d'urgence : un autre numéro.

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker say, "Our wait times are usually shortest in the afternoon"?
options: To encourage callers to use the website
To suggest the best time to call
questions.evidence: Our wait times are usually shortest in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: Après avoir invité à rappeler demain, elle indique que l'attente est plus courte l'après-midi : c'est un conseil sur le meilleur moment pour appeler.
questions.takeaway: Une information pratique en fin de message sert souvent de conseil implicite.
